message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What you need to know | |---------|-----------------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or whatever house rule you set). Points are tallied from the cards left in opponents’ hands when you finish a round. | | **Players** | 2–10 (standard deck). | | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue) × 25 cards each (one 0, two 1–9, two “Draw Two”, two “Skip”, two “Reverse”) + 4 “Wild” + 4 “Wild Draw Four”. | | **Setup** | • Shuffle the deck.
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining cards face‑down as the draw pile.
• Turn the top card of the draw pile face‑up to start the discard pile. If it’s a special card, apply its effect immediately (e.g., if it’s a “Draw Two”, the first player draws two and loses a turn). | | **Turn Order** | Players sit in a circle. The first turn goes to the player left of the dealer. “Reverse” flips the direction. | | **Playing a Card** | On your turn you may play **one** card that matches either:
• the color of the top discard card, **or**
• the number/symbol of the top discard card.
• A Wild card can be played on any card. | | **Special Cards** | | **Effect** | | **Draw Two** | Next player draws two cards and skips their turn. | | **Skip** | Next player loses their turn. | | **Reverse** | Reverses play direction (in a 2‑player game it acts like a Skip). | | **Wild** | You choose the new color. | | **Wild Draw Four** | You choose the new color; next player draws four cards and skips their turn. **(Can only be played if you have no other playable card; otherwise you risk a challenge.)** | | **If you can’t play** | Draw one card from the draw pile. If that card is playable, you may play it immediately; otherwise your turn ends. | | **Calling “Uno”** | When you have **exactly one card left**, you must say “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. If you forget and another player catches you, you must draw two cards as a penalty. | | **Winning a Round** | The first player to discard all their cards wins the round. | | **Scoring** | Add up the point values of the cards left in each opponent’s hand:
• Number cards: face value.
• Draw Two, Skip, Reverse: 20 points each.
• Wild, Wild Draw Four: 50 points each.
Winner gets those points. | | **Game End** | Play continues until a player reaches the target score (commonly 500). | --- ### Quick Tips 1. **Keep an eye on the discard pile** – you can anticipate what the next player might play. 2. **Save your Wild Draw Four** for when you’re down to one card; it can finish the round instantly. 3. **Use “Reverse” strategically** – in a 2‑player game it’s a handy way to skip your opponent. 4. **Challenge a Wild Draw Four** if you suspect the player had a playable card. If you’re wrong, you draw four instead of them. Enjoy the colorful chaos!
